# Upstream provenance

`vless-server.sh` is an unmodified snapshot of the owner's existing project:

- Repository: https://github.com/mozisen/surge
- Commit: `8dfe4d0da1383ecde6bcd2c43227c5d407ecd7c5`
- Version: 3.7.2
- SHA-256: `efdb8e151a05e7ed1b0ce9ed0e48cff39d2c77b574d7f079435eb708fe983b03`
- Original author attribution remains in the script. No upstream license was present in the source snapshot; no new license is asserted over this file.

The agent loads only the definitions before the final CLI dispatch into a private temporary file. It calls an allowlist of binary installers and the scoped Snell counter-port update helper. It never drives the interactive menu or sources a downloaded/latest script. Existing node scripts are not replaced. Runtime configuration changes are performed by the instance-scoped Python adapter; this keeps other protocols and routing settings intact.
